deviations.to: subtype SYNTH carrying the slot's assessment objectives (AO2, AO3) and the slot's Bloom level (Apply)
deviations.why: the v0.2.0 learning-items schema has no DIAGRAM subtype; SYNTH is the schema's carrier of joined AO2/AO3 reasoning. The marking guidance still names every DIAGRAM answer part (axes labelled, original curves drawn and labelled, the shift or movement in the correct direction, new equilibrium marked and labelled, what the diagram shows in words), the answer is a precise verbal walk-through of the supply diagram the syllabus guidance for 2.8.2 asks for, and the prompt avoids the words chart and graph because this subject declares no chart model and C-35 and C-41 would otherwise demand a rendered depiction.
